needscope.reading: Belonging is crowded — Amul and Nandini both own family ubiquity and value, while Dodla, Arokya and Jersey cluster in Security around 'pure and fresh' health reassurance. Heritage today straddles that Security-Belonging seam but has no distinct emotional claim. The open whitespace is Power: no dairy brand credibly owns purity as a source of strength, giving Heritage a defensible bridge from trusted-purity into farm-verified nourishing strength.

cb: Bought as a routine daily-delivery staple — habit, not active preference.
Chosen mainly for reliable freshness at the neighbourhood level; brand is interchangeable with Dodla or Arokya.
Under-represented in the mother's 'nutrition' decisions — milk is functional, not a considered health choice.
db: Actively chosen by the 25-44 woman as the milk she trusts to nourish her family every day.
Traded up within the franchise: standard milk to fortified, curd, ghee and value-added nutrition range.
Preferred for the 'growing family' occasion — kids' nutrition, morning ritual, elder care.
cb_ca_db_da.ca_quote: It's a fresh local milk brand — good enough, but I couldn't tell you why it's better than the others.
ca_declarative: A dependable supplier, not a chosen ally.
cb_ca_db_da.da_quote: Heritage comes straight from farmers I can picture, checked every single day — that's the purity I want feeding my family.
da_declarative: Active pride in a knowable source.
Purity felt as everyday strength for those I love.
cb_ca_db_da.caption: Layer a visible, farmer-sourced purity story on top of Heritage's existing freshness trust — deepen the everyday reliability into active, verified nourishment rather than replacing it.
cb_ca_db_da.shift_line: From dependable local freshness to chosen farm-verified nourishment.

fields.smp: Heritage: pure milk, straight from farmers, quality-checked to nourish every day.

smp_defence.why_collapses: Claims trust and scale but its aggregated national supply cannot promise farmer-fresh, daily source verification — purity is generic, not traceable.
Owns farmer ownership but leans on affordability and regional loyalty, not a daily quality-checked purity promise.
Says 'pure and fresh' as reassurance but frames it as processing hygiene, not a visible, verified farm-to-family sourcing story.
Talks freshness and farm collection but has no distinct emotional ownership of purity-as-daily-nourishment for the family.
Claims quality and consistency but lacks the farmer-source narrative and the every-day nutrition credential to hold this ground.

smp_unlocks.brand_line: Pure milk. Pure nutrition. Straight from our farmers, every day. (illustrative — not final copy)
smp_unlocks.mass_line: Har boond, kisan se seedha — roz jaanchi gayi shuddhata. (illustrative — not final copy)
smp_unlocks.activation: 'Meet Your Farmer' traceability — a QR on every pack showing the collection village and the day's quality check, plus a mothers'-community farm-visit programme. (illustrative — not final copy)
